symptom: ako/mxcli#1864 / mendixlabs/mxcli#1706: `ContentParams: ({1} = Starts format (dateFormat: custom, customDateFormat: 'd MMM yyyy, HH:mm'))` — check and exec clean, but the runtime shows the default date format (the report's `diff` churn did not reproduce on PedApp 11.13: a create-or-replace rerun diffs clean with the pre-fix binary too)
cause: MDL-WIDGET18 accepts dateFormat/enumFormat case-insensitively, but formattingInfoFromParamFormat copied the value verbatim, so the BSON held "DateFormat": "custom" — not a Mendix enum value. The date picker's path (inputFormattingInfo) already went through pages.CanonicalDateFormat; the template-parameter path never did
fix: Canonicalise dateFormat via pages.CanonicalDateFormat and enumFormat via the new pages.CanonicalEnumFormat. The converter is the one source for every ClientTemplateParameter FormattingInfo (dynamic text, Data grid 2 column templates, ALTER PAGE column path), so all of them are covered
test: mdl/executor TestFormattingInfoFromParamFormat_EnumCase (custom, datetime, TIME, enumformat image; control Custom). Fails on main with "custom" stored; bson dump on PedApp 11.13 shows DateFormat "custom" before the fix
insight: The report read as a drop ("stored with only customDateFormat") but the value was stored — in a spelling Mendix reads as the default. A validator that lowercases before checking an enum and a writer that does not is the shape to grep for: compare every strings.ToLower in a check against the matching store, since the existing test passed `Custom` capitalised and so never exercised the gap
